purpose: Teach: 乳児/遺骨/銃弾/勾留/留置/採血/病的/課さ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、乳児健診を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team carries out infant checkups with real care.
lines.style: Calm physician's opening, the name spoken kindly. Unhurried, even pace, reassurance built into the steadiness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ご遺族と遺骨返還の手続きを医療チームで支援します
lines.en: Ren, our team also supports bereaved families through the process of having remains returned.
lines.style: Softer, weightier. Slow respectful pace on the mention of families, compassion audible but controlled.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、銃弾摘出の手術を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team takes charge of surgeries to remove bullets.
lines.style: Clinical steadiness. Even, precise delivery, no drama on the word bullets, just quiet competence.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、勾留中の被疑者の健康診断を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, our team handles the health examinations of suspects being held in detention.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, measured. Slight care on the word detention, keeping any judgment out of her voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、留置場での医療提供を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our team provides medical care inside the holding cells as well.
lines.style: Even and practical. Unhurried pace, a small emphasis marking the unusual setting without dwelling on it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、定期採血、つまり採血検査を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren, we perform the routine blood draws — blood tests, that is — carefully as a team.
lines.style: Gentle teaching tone on the clarification. Slow, deliberate, the word carefully softly stressed.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の病的不安を医療チームで丁寧に対応します
lines.en: Ren, when a patient suffers from pathological anxiety, our team responds with great care.
lines.style: Voice warms and slows. Sitting-down-to-explain gentleness, extra care wrapped around the word anxiety.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、保険で課された自己負担を医療チームで丁寧に説明します
lines.en: Ren, we also take the time to carefully explain the out-of-pocket costs imposed by insurance.
lines.style: Closing with quiet thoroughness. Calm, even pace, ending on a note of dependable reassurance.
